rawFindings.title: Incorrect regex usage breaks detection of multiple spaces
rawFindings.explanation: The regex was changed from /( {2,})( [+*{?]|[^+*{?]|$)/ to /( {2,})+?/, which no longer captures the space group followed by certain characters properly, thus breaking the detection logic of multiple spaces in regex patterns.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert the regex to the original /( {2,})( [+*{?]|[^+*{?]|$)/ to restore the intended matching behavior.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect count calculation for multiple spaces
rawFindings.explanation: The code changed from counting regexResults[1].length (the first capturing group) to regexResults[0].length (the entire match), causing wrong count of spaces for fixing the regex spacing.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore count to be regexResults[1].length to correctly count the number of spaces in the matched group.
